newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-South Australia score first Shield win.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-South Australia score first Shield win.

text.p: Defending Sheffield Shield champions South Australia scored their first win of the season on Monday when they defeated joint leaders Queensland by nine wickets.
South Australia, who linger at the bottom of the Shield standings, lost just one wicket in reaching their winning target of 51 midway through the fourth and final day.
Queensland resumed on 220 for seven in their second innings, still requiring another 80 runs to make South Australia bat again after the visitor's massive first innings of 527 for six declared.
All-rounder Geoff Foley offered spirited resistance at the end of the innings, making 72 before Queensland were dismissed for 350.
Opener Ben Johnson and number three batsman Jeff Vaughan then steered South Australia past their meagre target, Johnson making 23 not out and Vaughan an unbeaten 10.
